_about: Machine-readable part of an experiment (experiments/E<id>_<slug>/experiment.json, next to the human experiment.md from templates/experiment.md). Checked by autoresearch/tools/experiment.py check; decided by autoresearch/tools/decide.py --experiment. Plain JSON, no JSON-Schema library: 'required' lists the fields that must exist, 'types' their python types, 'enum' the allowed values, 'fields' the meaning.

fields.card: the hypothesis card it tests (H<cycle>.<n>) or empty
fields.title: short title
fields.kind: variant = a config change only (experiment file -> run -> decide -> one summary line); block = new code (detail plan -> code + review -> run)
fields.metric: the headline metric the verdict is about (e.g. Q); its band is 'band'
fields.direction: higher | lower: which way is better for the headline metric
fields.band: noise band of the headline metric (S / Q: 0.010); inside it the arms tie
fields.prediction: {value: number, vs: <arm letter>}: the predicted headline effect (variant minus vs), written before the run
fields.arms: {<letter>: {names: [registry names, one per seed] | cards: [card refs, one per seed] | {subset: card ref | [card refs]}, run_ids: [...], recipe | command, base, set, seeds, note}}; a card ref is a path relative to the problem folder, optionally '#a/b/c' into the JSON (a card has its metrics under 'metrics', a flat dict is taken as the metrics)
fields.control: the arm letter of the matched reference (equal budget, same frames)
fields.variant: the arm letter that is judged (default: the first arm that is not the control)
fields.rule: list of clauses, ALL must hold for KEEP: {metric, vs?: <arm letter, default control>, min_effect?: number (variant - vs >= this), max_loss?: number (variant - vs >= -this), band?: number, subsets?: [subset names], at_least?: int (how many subsets must pass), note?}
fields.kill: stop early when ... (text; a tick can act on it once learning curves are recorded)
fields.evaluate: {split: val | test | confirm, subset?: val250, compare: <control arm letter>, allow?: [split | subset | denominator | protocol]}: how the cards are made (evaluate.py <name> --compare <control name>). decide.py refuses arms whose cards differ in split (must be this split), subset, denominator (frames / n) or protocol; allow names a difference you know and accept
fields.seeds: the seeds every arm runs: a list as long as an arm's cards pairs the cards of the arms seed by seed (a card's own `seed` wins; an arm can carry its own `seeds` list)
fields.pairing: 'position' = the cards of two arms are paired by their order in the lists (card i against card i), for experiments whose cards carry no seed identity; without seeds and without this declaration decide.py refuses to pair two or more seeds
fields.deterministic: true when the arms share the checkpoint and differ by a deterministic step (assembly, pruning, threshold): no training seed exists, the paired scene-bootstrap interval decides

verdicts.KEEP: headline effect beyond the band in the better direction, every paired seed on the same side, the paired-bootstrap interval (when a compare card exists) excludes 0, and every clause holds
verdicts.CUT: headline effect beyond the band in the worse direction, or a max_loss guard violated, or a min_effect clause missed with agreeing seeds
verdicts.TIE: headline effect inside the band and no guard violated: take the cheaper arm
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: beyond the band but one seed only, seeds disagree, or the interval contains 0: add a seed, do not adopt
